name: Han'nin
source:
A meth addict who assaulted someone and ran away from the police 17 years prior.

[spoiler]He held [url=/c129946]Kotone[/url] hostage and killed her in a fit of paranoia caused by meth withdrawal. [url=/c74744]Tateno[/url] blames himself for being unable to apprehend him in time to save Kotone.[/spoiler]
